notes: Heaviest rain of the window, mostly in the evening peak (5 pm and 7 pm).
A short 5 pm downpour (about 4.6 mm in an hour) on the Thursday before the exodus.
KSRTC's extra outbound buses begin. Light showers fall between 3 and 6 pm.
Weekend. Outbound specials continue; light rain around 6 pm.
Karnataka regional holiday (Sunday). Naraka Chaturdashi in KSRTC's calendar. Last day of outbound specials.
Karnataka regional holiday (Monday). Deepavali Amavasya in Karnataka's calendar; some North-Indian calendars place Lakshmi Puja a day earlier. Day 0 of this brief.
Balipadyami in KSRTC's calendar. Return specials begin. Whether it is a Karnataka holiday is not confirmed in the sources we found.
Return specials continue. First full working day for many.

ksrtc.discounts: 5% for groups of four or more; 10% on a booked return

baseline.rank: 2nd most congested city worldwide (TomTom Traffic Index 2025)
baseline.dispute: Bengaluru Traffic Police put peak-hour speed at about 18.2 km/h and 34.5 minutes per 10 km

pinch.what: About 4.2 km of queue from Nelamangala, five to six times the usual, on a holiday return; traffic police also cited a 60–70% rise on Tumakuru Road versus a regular weekday.
Worst on the Monday morning after an earlier Deepavali, with delays building on the main roads out of the city from about 2:45 pm the Sunday before; rain worsened the Kunigal bypass.
pinch.when: An earlier Deepavali (year not stated in the source we could read)

pinch.what: Traffic police named Goraguntepalya, Hebbal, Majestic, Old Madras Road, Mysuru Road and Hosur Road for a festival long weekend.
pinch.when: A festival weekend (date not shown in the source)

pinch.what: Passengers reported waits of 20–30 minutes to board after a Deepavali return.
